en.p: For a point $\mathrm{A}$ on the sphere $S:\ x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}=36$ in coordinate space, a point $\mathrm{B}$ on sphere $S$ satisfies the following conditions.

box: (A) For the point $\mathrm{C}$ on segment $\mathrm{OA}$ with $\overline{\mathrm{OC}}=4$, line $\mathrm{BC}$ is parallel to the $xy$-plane.
(B) If $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are the acute angles that lines $\mathrm{OA}$ and $\mathrm{AB}$ make with the $xy$-plane, respectively, then $\sin\alpha=3\sin\beta$.

en.p: When the orthogonal projection of triangle $\mathrm{OAB}$ onto the $xy$-plane is a right triangle, let $\theta$ be the acute angle between plane $\mathrm{OAB}$ and the $xy$-plane. What is the value of $\cos\theta$? (Here $\mathrm{O}$ is the origin, and the $z$-coordinate of point $\mathrm{A}$ is positive and not equal to 6.) [4 points]
